name: Will removing my pool increase my property value?

mainEntity.name: Does pool demolition usually help or hurt resale value in Los Angeles neighborhoods?
mainEntity.text: Does pool demolition usually help or hurt resale value in Los Angeles neighborhoods?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pool removal can help resale value when the pool is outdated, costly to maintain, or a safety concern, but the outcome depends heavily on the neighborhood and buyer profile. In some Los Angeles luxury areas, a pool is still expected and may support value. In other neighborhoods, a larger usable yard can be more attractive than an aging pool. The best decision usually depends on how the property is used, what nearby homes offer, and whether the site can be redesigned into a more functional outdoor space. Homeowners thinking about resale should consider whether the pool is a liability, how much repair it would need, and whether the yard will look more open and usable after removal. A contractor or designer can help estimate whether the reclaimed space will support landscaping, entertaining areas, or future construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removing an old pool can increase buyer interest if the pool is unused, damaged, or expensive to maintain. In some luxury markets, a well-kept pool still adds appeal, so the value impact depends on neighborhood expectations, lot size, and future use of the yard.
